nodes.title: Root Access
nodes.text: Every ability you use counts as your home discipline for node bonuses. You can't allocate any other keystone.

nodes.title: Hired Muscle
nodes.text: +15% Mercenary damage. Mercenary CONTACT abilities cost 1 less AP (min 1).

nodes.title: Contract Killer
nodes.text: Knocking out an enemy refunds 3 AP. -15% maximum health.

nodes.title: Collateral
nodes.text: Mercenary abilities also hit 1 adjacent enemy for 30% damage.

nodes.title: Backstab
nodes.text: +30% Rogue damage against enemies that can't see you.

nodes.title: Shadowstep
nodes.text: Rogue abilities used from stealth deal double damage and don't break stealth on a KO. -20% Defense.

nodes.title: Slip Away
nodes.text: Moving costs 20% less AP while in stealth.

nodes.title: Opportunist
nodes.text: +20% Rogue damage against enemies below 50% health.

nodes.title: Glitch in the Matrix
nodes.text: After using a Trickster ability, teleport up to 2 tiles for free. Trickster abilities cost +1 AP.

nodes.title: Misdirect
nodes.text: Confused enemies take +15% damage from you.

nodes.title: Slippery Floor
nodes.text: Surfaces you create last 1 turn longer.

nodes.title: Shield Wall
nodes.text: +15% Defense. Adjacent allies take 10% less damage.

nodes.title: Hold the Line
nodes.text: Take 20% less damage if you didn't move this turn.

nodes.title: Bulwark
nodes.text: Take 30% of the damage dealt to adjacent allies in their place. +30% maximum health. Moving costs 50% more AP.

nodes.title: Challenge
nodes.text: Crusader abilities taunt the target for 1 turn.

nodes.title: Righteous Charge
nodes.text: +15% Paladin damage. Paladin HELPFUL abilities also grant +5 Defense for 2 turns.

nodes.title: Aegis Protocol
nodes.text: Once per battle, the first ally reduced to 0 health is left at 1 instead. Paladin abilities cost +1 AP.

nodes.title: Smite
nodes.text: Paladin HARMFUL abilities heal you for 15% of damage dealt.

nodes.title: Hotfix
nodes.text: Cleric healing abilities also remove 1 harmful effect.

nodes.title: Restore Point
nodes.text: Overhealing becomes a shield (up to 25% of maximum health). Cleric HARMFUL abilities deal 30% less damage.

nodes.title: Read the Logs
nodes.text: Diviner abilities reveal stealthed enemies in their area.

nodes.title: Long Range
nodes.text: +2 range on all abilities. -25% damage against adjacent enemies.

nodes.title: Kindling
nodes.text: +15% fire, frost, water and electric damage.

nodes.title: Overclock
nodes.text: +40% Sorcerer damage. Sorcerer abilities cost +1 AP and cost 5% of your maximum health.

nodes.title: Conductor
nodes.text: Sorcerer abilities that hit a surface spread it 1 tile.

nodes.title: Leech
nodes.text: Heal for 10% of Necromancer damage dealt.

nodes.title: Garbage Collector
nodes.text: When any creature is knocked out within 3 tiles, heal 20% of maximum health and gain 2 AP. You can't be healed by allies.

nodes.title: Blood Price
nodes.text: Warlock abilities can be paid with health instead of AP (10% of maximum health per AP).

nodes.title: Forbidden Pact
nodes.text: +50% Warlock damage. Lose 5% of maximum health at the start of each of your turns.

nodes.title: Exploit
nodes.text: Warlock HARMFUL effects also reduce the target's Defense by 5 for 2 turns.

nodes.title: Rogue/Trickster start
nodes.text: Hybrid start between Rogue and Trickster.

nodes.title: Rogue/Mercenary start
nodes.text: Hybrid start between Rogue and Mercenary.

nodes.title: Sorcerer/Warlock start
nodes.text: Hybrid start between Sorcerer and Warlock.

notes.text: Full tree draft: first pass, every value is a placeholder to tune
25 points from Friendship. Own keystone ~8 from a start, a neighbor's ~15. Dashed rings = kitty starts. Root Access (center) = generalist.
